mechanics.claim: Eclipse's cooldown begins on cast, not after the detonation.

The shield's damage reduction is applied before other damage modifiers (pre-mitigation), capped at 50% of the incoming damage instance, so it reduces damage taken during its 3-second (or extended) duration.
mechanics.quote: flat {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} damage reduction of up to 50% of the damage instance

mechanics.claim: Casting or the detonation of Eclipse does not interrupt Leona's current orders or an ongoing attack windup, so it does not reset her attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Neither the cast nor detonation of ''Eclipse'' interrupts any of '''Leona's''' previous orders or ongoing attack windups.

mechanics.claim: The bonus armor/MR ratio recalculates continuously over the buff's duration based on Leona's current bonus resistances (excluding Eclipse's own flat bonus).
mechanics.quote: The resistance scaling will factor from all other sources, excluding ''Eclipse's'' flat bonus. This will recalculate over the duration.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the detonation's magic damage, but does not prevent the guard-duration extension it would otherwise grant.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the damage but ''Eclipse's'' extended duration will not be prevented.
